subject: [video] R2 correction: 256 matrix cases, 518/518 total; added exact-bound + 4096x2304 tests (commit b0a4984)
body:
Correction to my DONE message (honesty on the count): the line I read as "500 oracle cases" was $pass/$total including the unit checks. The real numbers are:
  unit 126 checks x 2 configurations (ASan+UBSan and plain -O2) = 252;
  bit-exact oracle matrix = 256 cases (not 500);
  ASan subset 6, TSan 2, trace_headers 1, iOS compile 1;
  total N2TEST R2 PASS 518/518.
The matrix still covers 16x16/32x32/176x144/178x146/320x240/640x480/1280x720 x 5 patterns x QP 10/20/26/32/40/51 x intra/P x 1/4/9/16 slices, all bit-exact.
While auditing against the PLAN 8 checklist I also added two unit cases: exact-size heap planes (ASan redzones immediately after each plane, so a picture-boundary overread would be caught) and a 4096x2304 (256x144 MB) bounds run at the documented maximum. 126/126 under ASan+UBSan and under plain.
New commit b0a4984 (on top of aa8f4ad): tests, run_tests.sh's matrix counter, STATUS.md/STATUS.json counts. No filter change (the 518/518 run includes the same avc2/n2avc_deblock.c as aa8f4ad, unchanged). Command unchanged:
  bash gpu/video/avc/test/deblock/run_tests.sh
  -> N2TEST R2 PASS 518/518
The pending items in the DONE message (3 avc2/n2avc_core.c edits, the 8.4.1.1 P_Skip fix in avc/n2avc_inter.c, --deblock in the shared CLI, avc2 in build_ios.sh) are unchanged.
